title: Mean, Median and Mode of Grouped Data
summary: Class marks, the direct method for the mean, the median formula and ogive, and the mode formula.
objectives: I can find the mean of grouped data.
I can find the median using the formula and an ogive.
I can find the mode of grouped data and choose the best average.
misconceptions: The modal class’s midpoint is the mode.
The median class is the middle class in the table.
The mean of grouped data is exact.
